reuse.why: The change reuses spreadsheet, averaging, batching and undo helpers, but introduces separate group-note storage and leaves existing actions outside its shared bulk-action abstractions.

duplication.why: Average actions share their selection and execution, but copyPreviousMonth duplicates eligibility rules, setZero retains its own income guard, and setBulkAverage repeats setNMonthAvg's amount calculation.

placement.why: Budget orchestration belongs in actions.ts, but adding category_groups.notes bypasses the existing notes table and notes service used for group notes.

scope.why: The edits address the requested budget actions and supporting persistence, although the parallel group-note schema is unnecessary given the existing storage.

maintainability.why: The shared helpers improve the average actions, but fragmented eligibility policies and two group-note representations leave maintainers with competing definitions to update.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getBulkBudgetCategories reads a new category_groups.notes field instead of existing group notes in the notes table; copyPreviousMonth bypasses shared bulk selection, and setZero bypasses shared eligibility and execution.

disguised_duplication.where: actions.ts expresses hidden/template eligibility both as SQL in getBulkBudgetCategories and as has_templates plus local guards in copyPreviousMonth, while setBulkAverage reshapes setNMonthAvg's averaging and sign conversion into a callback.

abstraction_drift.where: includeHiddenCategories adds one selection parameter and a conditional hidden-filter bypass; copyPreviousMonth retains independent selection and eligibility, while setZero retains its own income guard and write loop outside setBulkBudgets.
